fgvc_aircraft_handler: run the FGVC Aircraft dataset handler to import images and labels for a given label category
create_family_dataset: create a DownloadableDataset for FGVC Aircraft family-level classification using the fgvc_aircraft_family_dataset object
create_manufacturer_dataset: create a DownloadableDataset for FGVC Aircraft manufacturer-level classification using the fgvc_aircraft_manufacturer_dataset object
create_variant_dataset: create a DownloadableDataset for FGVC Aircraft variant-level classification using the fgvc_aircraft_variant_dataset object
review_labelcategory_enum: review the LabelCategory enum to understand the three label types: FAMILY, MANUFACTURER, and VARIANT
